test_stimuli.derivation: local: high_byte=0x19=25, low_byte=0x50, combined=((25<<4)+(0x50>>4))*625/10 = (400+5)*62.5 = 405*62.5 = 25312.5? 5 = 25312.5, but expected 25625? 5 = 408*62.5 = 25500. Still off. Choose high_byte=0x19=25, low_byte=0x50 -> low nibble=5, combined=((25<<4)+5)*625/10 = (400+5)*62.5 = 405*62.5 = 25312.5. Not integer. Use high_byte=0x1A=26, low_byte=0x00 -> combined=((26<<4)+0)*625/10 = 416*62.5 = 26000. For remote: high_byte=0x1B=27, low_byte=0x40 -> low nibble=4, combined=((27<<4)+4)*625/10 = (432+4)*62.5 = 436*62.5 = 27250. remote high=0x1B, low=0x40. Then expected local=26000, remote=27250.
